basic_profile.bio: A passionate audiophile and music producer based in Portland, Oregon. With a background in audio engineering and a love for all things tech, I spend my days tinkering with soundscapes and helping others find their rhythm. Outside of music, I enjoy hiking the Pacific Northwest trails with my partner and our two dogs. Typically online during the evenings, especially after work as a freelance sound designer, where I create audio for indie games and films. In a committed relationship, we often collaborate on creative projects, blending our interests in music and art.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: I have a degree in Audio Engineering and over a decade of experience in music production. My expertise spans across various DAWs, with a focus on Ableton Live and Pro Tools. I am self-taught in many areas, constantly learning through online courses and community forums.
